searchText: 👍 How´s altona testnet doin? https://altona.beaconcha.in/ showed all slots as "orphaned" for about 10 minutes not sure if it was a network issue or not, but explorer is working again <@!707707212184944702> happened at this block if i remember correctly @ epoch 884 https://altona.beaconcha.in/blocks?q=28288 same proposer, different graffiti <-- might be an issue in our db <@!584920944762552346> are you running the same validator on Teku & prysm? <@97774605351010304> no, no duplicate validators and I'm only running lighthouse and prysm. Something weird - my prysm validator gave this error for a future slot three hours ago. (Prysm was built the day before Altona launch) `Jul 03 04:41:32 staking-green validator[95923]: time="2020-07-03 04:41:32" level=error msg="Could not request attestation to sign at slot" error="rpc error: code = InvalidArgument desc = Attestation request must be within current or previous epoch" prefix=validator pubKey=0x9061dcdd23bd slot=29157` https://altona.beaconcha.in/validator/664#blocks As butta mentioned, validator 664 shows slot 28288 from teku, but this is my validator and I don't have a teku node. > <https://altona.beaconcha.in/validator/664#blocks> As butta mentioned, validator 664 shows slot 28288 from teku, but this is my validator and I don't have a teku node. Two blocks at the same slot has confused the db on our end, we'll need to dig in deeper just wanted to make sure its not a network related issue Same with validator 663,. I wish i could provide beacon node logs for whatever happened but i don't have them. anyone know what happened with the reported network liveness here? > anyone know what happened with the reported network liveness here? Maybe the same problem we talked about before? <@!291925846556540928> <@!97774605351010304> not an issue in our db from what i have been told https://altona.beaconcha.in/epoch/881 looks like it might be a block explorer/api bug. most blocks were produced during that epoch, and many attestations (with correct target) were included yeah, just checked my lighthouse node and it's reporting 89.68% correct target participation for epoch 881 Prysm reports ```json { "epoch": "881", "finalized": true, "participation": { "globalParticipationRate": 0.8858132, "votedEther": "40960000000000", "eligibleEther": "46240000000000" } } ``` funny that the percentage voting is slightly off in the calculations from prysm to lighthouse _but_ at least they agree there was a lot of activity what doe `votedEther` mean? managed to get a vote on chain at all (so at least correct source), or is it target or head? I believe voted ether means the amount of eligible ETH where their assigned attestations were included on chain gotcha so that rate is votedEther/eligibleEther i think anyway, <@!363800010518822915> knows more about it right I'm seeing the following for epoch 882 (so previous here is 881) ``` { "current_epoch_active_gwei": 46240000000000, "previous_epoch_active_gwei": 46240000000000, "current_epoch_attesting_gwei": 37952000000000, "current_epoch_target_attesting_gwei": 37952000000000, "previous_epoch_attesting_gwei": 41472000000000, "previous_epoch_target_attesting_gwei": 41472000000000, "previous_epoch_head_attesting_gwei": 41408000000000 } ``` also i think votedEther is may be gwei so that isn't a great property name on our end ```json { "epoch": "882", "finalized": true, "participation": { "globalParticipationRate": 0.86020756, "votedEther": "39776000000000", "eligibleEther": "46240000000000" } } ``` 882 ^ <https://altona.beaconcha.in/charts/network_liveness> epoch 857 ```{ "epoch": "857", "finalized": true, "participation": { "globalParticipationRate": 0.901360631, "votedEther": "568160000000000", "eligibleEther": "630336000000000" } }``` same, my local node says plenty vote percentage on the epochs around 857 https://altona.beaconcha.in/epoch/857 and the explorer says similarly whereas explorer says 1ETH voted in https://altona.beaconcha.in/epoch/881 yeah weird why the network liveness spiked we'll look into it on monday, at least it's explorer related thanks <@!97774605351010304> ! (killer job by the way. I'm using beaconcha.in many times daily 🙂 ) all <@!514429265001971732> and <@!577788234810130432> 😄 i just come up with the ideas 😅 music to our ears tho, i bet we'll sleep well tonight happy 1000 epochs
